Broadcast Theme — Feature Proposal

Mix & Match Bundle Builder

Prepared by: LitOS/LitGroup
Date: August 7, 2026
1

Recommendation

Custom-build the bundle page on Broadcast Theme, paired with a dedicated Shopify Function for the quantity-tiered pricing.

2

Answers to your questions

Can this be built on Broadcast Theme?

Yes.

Custom development, or a Shopify bundle app?

Custom development.

Shopify Functions or Automatic Discounts for the quantity-tiered discount?

A dedicated Shopify Function.

Does the discount recalculate automatically when items are removed or quantities change in the cart?

Yes, automatically — the 4→3 product transition (20% → 15%) and dropping below 3 products (discount removed) happen automatically, no manual action needed.

Does the discount apply only to eligible bundle products, without affecting regular products also in the cart?

Yes. Products purchased directly outside the bundle page are not discounted, even if they're the same product.

If a bundle app were used, could the UI be customized to match the reference page?

Not applicable — custom development is recommended instead of an app, to guarantee a 100% match to the reference page's design.

3

Scope

  • Built as a dedicated page template; product lists and page content are configurable via section settings.
  • Products listed grouped by category, freely selectable across categories.
  • Real-time summary panel: number of products selected, discount rate applied, original total, discounted total.
  • Add or remove selected products directly from the summary panel.
  • Quick view: uses Broadcast Theme's default quick view, with the "Add to Cart" button changed to "Add to Bundle".
  • Variant selection for products with options.
  • Out-of-stock products are not selectable.
  • Single "Add to Cart" action for all selected products.
  • Buying the same product through the bundle page and elsewhere results in two separate cart lines — the discount applies only to the line added through the bundle page.
  • Capped at 4 products per bundle — once 4 slots are filled, no further selection or overwriting, matching the reference page's behavior.
  • Responsive on desktop and mobile.
  • The Hair Quiz section is not included.
